['Kuka AG '].company_description: KUKA AG is a German manufacturer of industrial robots and factory automation systems. It is owned by Chinese appliance manufacturer Midea Group. The company operates globally and provides products and services for task automation in the industrial processing of metallic and non-metallic materials for various industries including automotive, energy, aerospace, rail vehicles, and agricultural machinery.

['Vaillant Group '].company_description: The Vaillant Group is a company that develops products for heating, cooling, and hot water. It is a global market leader in the wall-hung boiler segment and focuses on the development of green, energy-saving, and environmentally friendly products. The company is family-owned and headquartered in Remscheid, North Rhine-Westphalia.
